_teacher_notes.purpose: Configure non-secret dashboard integrations. Host topology and service relationships now live in inventory/infrastructure-registry.yml.
_teacher_notes.inputs: Local Prometheus URL, optional local UniFi controller URL, and deliberate offline-device exceptions.
_teacher_notes.outputs: Server-side UniFi configuration only. Infrastructure identity and parent/guest placement come from /api/registry.
change_instructions: Never put the UniFi API key or another secret in this browser-served file.
Do not add host parent/guest relationships here; edit inventory/infrastructure-registry.yml instead.
Keep integration URLs limited to non-secret local endpoints.
After editing, validate JSON, run server/layout tests, publish the dashboard, and test the UniFi endpoint.
